newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end stable on rupiah, focus on Panin.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end stable on rupiah, focus on Panin.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended stable on Friday as the rupiah stabilised, while the market focus in late trading turned to Bank Panin on news of a syndicated loan and talk of a possible restructuring, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was up 0.50 points, or 0.07 percent, at the close at 721.77 points. Advancers led decliners by 67 to 52 with 73 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 433 billion rupiah.
"The market was largely stable most of the day due to the generally stable rupiah against the dollar," one broker said.
The rupiah was quoted at 2,608.00/12.00 against the dollar at the close of Jakarta trading compared with 2,613.00/23.00 at the opening.
The rupiah had came under strong speculative attacks recently following a spillover from regional currencies.
Brokers said strong buying interest in shares belonging to the Panin group helped the index gain slightly despite active profit taking in many liquid second-liners.
Panin shares were actively traded on what brokers said was due partly to news of a syndicated loan and its expansion plans.
Panin Bank, Panin Life and Panin Insurance all made strong gains amid reports that Panin Bank had secured a $65 million syndicated overseas loan, one broker said

Another broker, however, said strong interest on Panin shares were likely to be more to do with talk of a possible restructuring involving the group as the loan reports were unlikely to have strong impact.
Panin Bank rose 200 rupiah to 1,625 rupiah, Panin Life was up 175 rupiah to 1,225 rupiah and Panin Insurance rose 75 rupiah to 975 rupiah.
Indah Kiat on the regular board was relatively quiet as it closed unchanged at 1,350 rupiah with only 743,000 shares traded despite reports of huge tradings on the cross board on Thursday.
Some 231.8 million Indah Kiat shares, slightly over four percent of the company's total equity, were crossed on Thursday.
Indah Kiat said on Friday it did not know the parties involved in the cross trades and that it was waiting for details.

Senior Indah Kiat official Harsono told Reuters that details would be lodged with Sinartama Gunita, the company entrusted with registering owners of its shares. But he added no details had yet emerged. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
